companies.name: Duke Energy Corporation
companies.description: Duke Energy is a regulated utility that primarily generates, transmits and distributes electricity and also operates natural gas distribution and energy services. They serve residential, commercial, industrial and wholesale customers and market themselves as delivering reliable energy while expanding renewable resources and modernizing grid infrastructure.

companies.name: American Electric Power Company, Inc.
companies.description: American Electric Power Company, Inc.  is a major investor-owned electric utility in the US, serving millions of customers with electricity generation, transmission, and distribution. AEP's typical customers include residential, commercial, and industrial users who rely on the company for reliable and affordable electricity. AEP differentiates itself through its commitment to sustainability, innovation in energy technology, and a focus on customer satisfaction.

companies.name: Quanta Services, Inc.
companies.description: Quanta Services, Inc. provides specialty contracting services for electric power, pipeline and communications infrastructure. They serve utilities, energy companies, telecommunications network owners and large industrial customers with engineering, construction, installation, maintenance and repair services. They position themselves as an integrated platform of specialized operating companies delivering end-to-end infrastructure solutions at scale for grid modernization, pipelines and communications networks.

companies.name: Ameren
companies.description: Ameren is a regulated energy company that generates, transmits, distributes and sells electricity and delivers natural gas to residential, commercial and industrial customers. They emphasize reliable energy delivery, grid modernization and investments in generation (including renewables) while offering outage management, billing, energy efficiency programs and related utility services for end users.

companies.name: Bentley systems Incorporated
companies.description: Bentley systems Incorporated provides software and services for the infrastructure design, construction, and operations industries. Their offerings include solutions for building information modeling (BIM), digital twins, and asset performance management. Their typical customers are engineering and construction firms, infrastructure owner-operators, and government agencies. Bentley Systems positions itself as a leader in digital twins and infrastructure engineering software, claiming to offer comprehensive and integrated solutions that enable their customers to improve project delivery and asset performance.
